recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, low-key photographic composition featuring a person's hand holding an ornate, jewel-encrusted crown against a dark, almost black background. The person wears a dark garment with intricate red and gold embroidery, and a beaded bracelet on their wrist. The lighting emphasizes the textures of the crown and fabric, creating a sense of luxury and mystery.
coreVisualRelationships: The hand firmly grasps the crown, signifying ownership or presentation.
The ornate crown stands out against the dark, minimalist background.
The embroidered garment provides a rich, textural contrast to the smooth skin and metallic crown.
The dark background creates a dramatic and focused atmosphere around the central elements.
coreInvariants: A hand holding a highly detailed, jewel-encrusted crown.
A dark, muted background that allows the crown and hand to be the focal point.
Rich, textural details on the clothing, contrasting with the smooth skin.
Low-key lighting creating dramatic shadows and highlights.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The hand and crown occupy the central-right portion of the frame, scaled to fill a significant portion of the vertical space, drawing immediate attention.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The glittering, golden crown serves as the primary visual anchor due to its brightness, intricate detail, and central placement.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye is drawn first to the crown, then follows the hand and arm upwards to the embroidered sleeve, and finally to the subtle text elements.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The substantial dark negative space on the left and bottom-left creates a sense of depth and allows the main subjects to stand out without distraction.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Dark charcoal/black serves as the dominant background color, providing a dramatic and sophisticated backdrop.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Gold and various jewel tones (blue, green, clear) in the crown, along with the reddish-brown of the bracelet and the red/gold embroidery, provide strong contrast against the dark background.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: The vibrant jewel tones within the crown and the subtle red embroidery on the garment act as accents, adding points of visual interest and richness.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: The background is low saturation and very low value. The foreground elements (crown, hand, embroidery) have higher saturation and varying values, with the gold and jewels being high value and high saturation, creating a striking contrast.
paletteRestrictions: Maintain a predominantly dark and muted background.
Ensure gold and jewel tones are rich and vibrant.
Limit the color palette to emphasize luxury and focus.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: The vertical text uses a sans-serif, monolinear, uppercase skeleton. The horizontal text uses a script, monolinear, lowercase skeleton.
letterConstructionRules: Vertical text: Uniform stroke width, open counters, geometric forms, slightly condensed.
Horizontal text: Flowing, connected strokes, variable stroke width mimicking handwriting, open counters, distinct ascenders and descenders.

composition.position: left edge, vertically oriented, centered vertically
composition.relationshipToImage: positioned on the dark background, not interacting with the main subject
positioned on the dark background, not interacting with the main subject

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast in style and orientation: a minimalist, geometric sans-serif for metadata paired with an expressive, flowing script for the main title.

preserve: Vertical orientation and tight leading for the metadata text.
Flowing, connected script style for the display text.
Light gold/cream color for both text elements.
Clear distinction between the two typographic styles.
avoid: Sans-serif fonts with high contrast or decorative elements for the metadata.
Blocky or disconnected script fonts for the display text.
Bold or dark colors for the text that would blend with the background.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Metadata: Montserrat, Lato, Open Sans (condensed versions)
candidateDirections.reason: These are clean, geometric sans-serifs that can be set in all caps with loose tracking and appear similar to the reference.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Display: Great Vibes, Dancing Script, Pacifico
candidateDirections.reason: These are flowing script fonts that capture the handwritten, elegant feel of the reference, with good connectivity between letters.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a close-up, low-key photograph of a hand holding an ornate, jewel-encrusted crown. The hand should be positioned in the central-right, wearing a dark, embroidered garment with red and gold patterns and a beaded bracelet. The background should be a dark, solid color, almost black, with subtle lighting that highlights the textures of the crown, hand, and fabric. Ensure dramatic shadows and highlights.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Overlay two text elements: 1. A small, light gold/cream, vertically oriented, all-caps sans-serif text on the far left, centered vertically. 2. A large, light gold/cream, horizontally oriented, flowing script text in the bottom-left corner.

verificationChecks: Are both text elements present and correctly positioned?
Does the vertical text use a clean, geometric sans-serif in all caps?
Does the horizontal text use a flowing, connected script?
Are both text elements light gold/cream in color?
Is the contrast between the text and the dark background sufficient for readability?

adjustableVariables: Specific patterns and colors of the embroidery on the garment.
Exact design and jewel placement on the crown.
Specific hue of the dark background (e.g., deep blue-black, charcoal).

mustAchieve: A sense of luxury and regality through the crown and embroidered garment.
Dramatic and focused lighting that highlights the main subject.
Clear readability of both text elements against the dark background.
avoid: Text colors that blend into the background or are difficult to read.

postGenerationChecks: Verify the crown appears rich and detailed, with visible jewels and metallic sheen.
Confirm the hand and garment textures are well-defined by the lighting.
Ensure the overall image maintains a dark, dramatic aesthetic.
Check that the vertical text is clearly legible and vertically aligned on the left.
Confirm the script text is flowing, legible, and positioned in the bottom-left.
Assess that the color of the text provides sufficient contrast with the background.
recipe.reuseFormula: Recreate a low-key photographic composition focusing on a hand holding an ornate crown, set against a dark background. The hand should be adorned with a bracelet and the arm covered by a richly embroidered garment. Overlay two distinct text elements: a small, vertically aligned, all-caps sans-serif on the left, and a large, horizontally aligned script text in the bottom-left, both in a light, contrasting color.
